SkillRecoveryJournalPercentage_tooltip:
The amount of experience recovered from reading bound journals.
This value is defaulted to if other options are set to -1.
SkillRecoveryJournalTranscribeSpeed_tool: A multiplier on the speed of transcribing journals.
SkillRecoveryJournalReadTimeSpeed_toolti: A multiplier on the speed of reading bound journals.
SkillRecoveryJournalTranscribeTVXP_toolt: Toggling this on will allow people to transcribe XP earned from watching TV/VHS. Note: This means players can carry over watched XP between characters cumulatively.
SkillRecoveryJournalRecoverPassiveSkills:
Recovery percentage for passive skills (Fitness + Strength).
Set this to -1 to use the General Skill Recovery Percentage.
SkillRecoveryJournalRecoverPhysicalCateg:
Recovery percentage for physical skills.
Set this to -1 to use the General Skill Recovery Percentage.

SkillRecoveryJournalRecoverRecipes_toolt: Toggle off to prevent journals from recovering/transcribing recipes.
SkillRecoveryJournalUsed_tooltip: Normally you can reread the journal as many times as you like - with this toggled on each individual XP point can only be recovered once. You can still add onto the journal, but each point can only be recovered once on each journal. Note: the tooltip for the journal will now display a fraction for unused points.
SkillRecoveryJournalCraftRecipe_tooltip:
Leaving this blank will use the default recipe.

Syntax follows vanilla/standard recipe inputs/ingredients.
These are fed directly into a recipe script's input{}. Example:
item 1 [Base.Notebook;Base.Journal;Base.Diary1;Base.Diary2;Base.Notepad] flags[Prop2] mode:destroy, item 1 tags[Glue] flags[Prop1], item 3 [Base.LeatherStrips;Base.LeatherStripsDirty] mode:destroy, item 1 [Base.Thread;Base.Yarn],
SkillRecoveryJournalCraftRecipeNeedLearn: If set to true, crafting the journal requires learning the recipe.\n\nCurrently there is no way to learn it, making the recipe uncraftable.
SkillRecoveryJournalModDataTrack_tooltip:
USE WITH CAUTION.

Example syntax: ModDataKey1|ModDataKey2
Transcription will store a copy of the corresponding table from the player's mod data. 
This can create significant issues if the data is large.
 If you're not sure what any of this means, ignore it, and leave blank.
SkillRecoveryJournalKillsTrack_tooltip:
Recovery percentage for Zombie and Survivor Kills.
Set this to -1 to use the General Skill Recovery Percentage.
SkillRecoveryJournal_SecurityFeatures_to: Whether journals check against username, steamID, both, or none. Warning: Disabling this entirely would mean people can share journals.
